headline: Two o'clock keeps its own counsel.
body: The sodium lamps have settled into their long stare. A fridge compressor kicks once and thinks better of it. We keep the desk lamp low and let the street decide whether Friday has finished with us.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: thin cloud, no moon to argue

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: empty bus lane, puddle holding a lamp
